eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Performance Evaluation and Modeling in Wireless and Wired Networks aims at providing a forum for sharing ideas and new research advances among researchers and practitioners working on state-of-the-art solutions in Wireless Networks, Internet of Things, Smart Cities and Internet of the Future. We are seeking papers that describe original and unpublished contributions addressing various aspects of performance evaluation of protocols, architectures and modeling of Wireless Networks, Cloud Computing, Internet of Everything, etc.
